title: Slowed twin: the twin's list question now settles it too
text: 1RB0RE_1RC0RC_1LD---_0LB1LE_1RF0LD_1RA1RF follows 1RB0RE_0RC---_1LD1LE_1LE1LD_1RF0LC_1RA1RF until a break, and its halting transitions are not the twin's. Lean now checks the twin's list-machine proof files, unchanged, on a watched copy of the twin that halts exactly at breaks, so the twin's hypothesis (its list machine never fails) rules out every break: under it neither machine halts. No break in the twin's first 3·10<sup>9</sup> steps.
